Resolves #19055

The v13.2 section of `ROADMAP.md` is replaced in place. It now names the engine's release as one of three release lines (engine 13.2, the Brain runtime images, the Institution / Fleet Manager), each on its own cadence with its own gate and notes — the engine's gate written down, the other two recorded as they stand — keeps the Knowledge Base prerequisite on the local plane beside the gate rather than inside it, retires "the first org-spanning release", lists all seven repositories with what the engine's release means for each and where its line stands, and carries seven priority-ordered cornerstones with live anchors and stewards read from the assignees — Knowledge Base currency first, then deploy topology and content scope, corpus consumers then mirror retirement, docking / Workstation / the film, the contributor door, notes and launch, local onboarding and the cockpit. The nine anchors that had been transferred out of this repository point at their new homes; anchors that closed under the section are marked completed; the deferred set is explicit and every entry resolves. Milestone #9 gained the four gating epics that carried no milestone (#18303, #17416, #15252, #18985), done directly per the `update-roadmap` step 6.

Evidence: L1 (documentation; every issue and discussion anchor resolved by `gh api` / `gh issue view` at 2026-09-23 00:1xZ, relative links checked by the `check-relative-links` job) → L1 required (AC-1 … AC-8 are observable on the file and the milestone). Residual: AC-9 (a fresh peer recovers the live epics from `ROADMAP.md` alone), Residual-Owner: #19055 stays the owner until a peer boots on it; it is a post-merge observation, not a code residual.

Micro-review eligible: no — it records a release-model decision (AC-8), so cross-family review is the gate.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; the shared PR baseline runs.
